posts.name: razor831
posts.cooked:
I put in my order this Sunday, set up shipping and all of that.  Ordered Enhanced Edition, all of the Expansions, and all of the mini-expansions except for Ambuscade.  Fifteen dollars for shipping, and so far my "arrive by" date according to FedEx is "N/A" and the last and only thing on the tracking log is from June 17 saying "Shipment information sent to FedEx."  I was really hoping to have the game by tonight for a gaming group.  NOW I'm just hoping I get it at all...but that shipping price is a joke if I can't even find out where my 120 dollars worth of merchandise is...

 

 

Edit: It just finally got picked up today.  Let's see if it's here by Saturday...I hate FedEx...
